title: GTA 6 is not coming to PC so I added cars to BOB
author: Blake9712
selftext:
That's right the most anticipated game of 2027 just got anticipateder! Us PC peasants may not get to play GTA but I decided who needs GTA? We have GTA at home!

  
All jokes aside I just like to share project updates on "Bob" it's a roguelite with 6 floors and 600 equipable items which change stats, abilities or the way the game plays. You play as BOB and essentially get drafted into vietnam where you have to stop the Vietkiong from doing 9/11 in 50 years but you get ambushed and isekei'd onto a fantasy world, the basics. 

The game is coded entirely by Claude but I spent the first few months having Claude make the asset Builder where all assets can be created or edited. Since Opus 5.5 I have had Claude help with assets as well. Sadly it has taken me about 8 months to get here and will not be finished until at least late next year. 

I really just wanted to show the new addition and progress thus far. You guys can technically play it if anyone wants [https://cbm971.github.io/BobAssetBuilder/game/](https://cbm971.github.io/BobAssetBuilder/game/) but i'd much rather people wait until Vietnam is finished in Late December and it's wrapped on Itch or something. 

  
Let me know if you guys have any suggestions or critisims. I'm trying to make BOB as good as I can but it's easy to overlook a feature or balance change. 

Thank you for coming to my Ted Talk.
